title: Quell
summary: QUELL, verb transitive 1. To crush; to subdue; to cause to cease; as, to quell an insurrection or sedition. 2. To quiet; to allay; to reduce to peace; as, to quell the tumult of the soul. 3. To subdue

inlines.v: QUELL, verb transitive 1. To crush; to subdue; to cause to cease; as, to quell an insurrection or sedition. 2.
